name: @togetherweown/paperclip-plugin-pr-doer-wake
description: Paperclip plugin: wakes the card that owns an open, non-draft GitHub pull request at most once per (PR, head SHA, state) when its Paperclip Review fails, a gating check fails or a merge conflict appears, and re-checks the head on ready_for_review and reopened. Never wakes drafts, closed or merged PRs, forks, outsiders, stopped repos or a card whose ownership is ambiguous. A lost host reply can miss a wake (counted as wake_unconfirmed); it never wakes twice.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
